citations.quote: Standardized uptake values (SUVmax) were recorded for all focal lesions.
A 2.5 cm (axial) solid pulmonary nodule in the posterior basal segment demonstrates intense FDG uptake (SUVmax 5.8).
**Primary right lower lobe lung mass** – FDG‑avid (SUVmax 12.5), consistent with known large‑cell carcinoma.

candidates.description: The maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) of the primary pulmonary lesion measured during 18F-FDG PET/CT imaging.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Locate the PET/CT findings section and extract the SUVmax value specifically associated with the primary pulmonary mass or solid nodule.
candidates.measurement_definition: Numeric value of SUVmax for the primary lung mass or nodule, as recorded in PET/CT reports.
candidates.name: primary_tumor_suvmax
candidates.uncertainty: The exact timing of the PET scan relative to the start of systemic therapy may vary between patients.

citations.quote: Brain MRI identified three enhancing lesions (right frontal, left cerebellar, occipital) consistent with metastatic disease.
Dedicated brain MRI demonstrates no enhancing lesions, restricted diffusion, or abnormal T2/FLAIR signal suggestive of metastasis.

candidates.description: Presence of metastatic disease within the brain at baseline assessment.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Review Brain MRI or PET/CT reports for mentions of 'intracranial enhancing lesions' or 'brain metastases'. Mark as positive if present; mark as negative if the report states 'no enhancing lesions, restricted diffusion, or abnormal T2/FLAIR signal suggestive of metastasis'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if MRI or PET imaging identifies enhancing lesions or abnormal signals compatible with metastatic disease; negative if imaging explicitly demonstrates no enhancing lesions or metastases.
candidates.name: brain_metastases_present
candidates.uncertainty: Whether 'brain metastases' includes leptomeningeal disease or only parenchymal lesions is not specified.

limitations: Small number of distinct patients represented in the provided chunks.
Variable reporting styles across different radiology and oncology notes.
summary: The provided clinical excerpts describe baseline characteristics of patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), specifically detailing the metabolic activity of the primary pulmonary tumor as measured by SUVmax on PET/CT and the presence or absence of intracranial metastases as identified by brain MRI.
